videos.title: Knee Reaping Rules - What's legal in IBJJF?
videos.whyUseful: Explains what constitutes knee reaping in IBJJF rules, common mistakes that lead to reaping, and how to avoid illegal positions when attacking legs.

videos.title: Easily Understand the Reaping Rule in BJJ
videos.whyUseful: Breaks down the reaping rule visually with clear examples of legal vs illegal leg positions, helping beginners understand the knee line.

videos.title: Is Knee Reaping Dangerous? BJJ Leglocks Part 4 of 5
